Noto Sans Regular is bundled at `app/assets/fonts/NotoSans-Regular.ttf` for identical font metrics in browser previews and PDF artwork. It is embedded in every PDF that contains text.

Source: https://github.com/notofonts/noto-fonts/blob/main/hinted/ttf/NotoSans/NotoSans-Regular.ttf
